name: impeccable
description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
one_liner: A rulebook and set of commands that stop AI-built websites from all looking the same (the same purple gradient, the same fonts) by teaching the AI real design judgment and checking its work automatically.
buyer: A solo founder or small agency shipping AI-generated web products who is embarrassed that every 'vibe-coded' site looks identical and generic.
business_use_cases: A solo SaaS founder uses it so their AI-built landing page doesn't look like every other AI-built landing page, improving conversion and credibility.
A no-code or low-code agency runs the audit command on every client delivery as an automated quality gate before sending work out.
A design-conscious dev shop sells an 'AI build plus design polish' package, using it to guarantee a non-generic look without hiring a dedicated designer.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid design-polish pass: run a client's AI-built site through the full command set and deliver a before/after report plus fixes.
Sell a premium design-token or theme pack that plugs into the tool for brands wanting a distinct starting aesthetic.

steal_this: This weekend, run the critique and audit commands against 5 real AI-generated sites you can find publicly, turn the worst offenses into a 'why your AI site looks generic' post, and offer a paid polish service to the replies.
